newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 18 killed in Colombia bus crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 18 killed in Colombia bus crash.

text.p: At least 18 people were killed and 25 others were injured on Saturday in a pre-dawn crash outside Colombia's Caribbean port of Barranquilla, authorities said.

Police said the accident occurred when the driver of a packed public bus attempted to pass another vehicle on the highway linking the port to the nearby resort of Santa Marta and careened into an oncoming truck.
Survivors told the NTC television news programme passangers had begged the 31-year-old bus driver to slow down and stop passing on curves shortly before the fatal accident.
The driver died on impact, as did the driver of the truck.
"It was definitely due to imprudence on the part of the bus driver," Col. Paulino Marca of the Barranquilla police told NTC.
